name: Ragefire Chasm

entrance.note: Cleft of Shadow; walk down the ramp from the Valley of Spirits / Cleft of Shadow. Coordinates from Questie dungeons.lua via research/dungeons/dungeons.json.

travel.how: From Razor Hill or the Crossroads, walk or fly into Orgrimmar and drop into the Cleft of Shadow; the portal is on the cavern floor.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.notes: Outdoor Durotar pickup: Lieutenant's Insignia from Burning Blade Fanatics/Apprentices in Skull Rock. Orc/Troll already do this in durotar-1-12; Tauren still need the dungeon-pack accept. Unlocks 5727.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.notes: Speak to Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow (49.5, 50.6) with the insignia, then return to Thrall. Unlocks 5728.

quests.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
quests.notes: Kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman inside. Catalog marks it low XP / balanced-only; take it if you pass Elder Rise anyway (Tauren naturally do).

quests.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
quests.notes: Turn in on Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside the instance (no outdoor coords). Leads to 5724.

quests.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
quests.notes: Accepted from Maur inside after 5722. Catalog speedrun:true (1450 base). Bracer rewards.

quests.name: The Power to Destroy...
quests.notes: Two books from Searing Blade Cultists/Warlocks inside. In dungeons.json as balanced+speedrun, but steps-v2 has no accept/turnin: giver is Undercity and the Horde RFC pickup is in Orgrimmar. Skip unless you are already in Undercity (do not add a zeppelin detour).

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.notes: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker inside. This is the dungeon step of the Hidden Enemies chain. Catalog balanced-only.

quests.name: Slaying the Beast
quests.notes: Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart. Giver is next to the RFC entrance. Catalog speedrun:true.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.notes: Talk-only follow-up after 5728. Not in dungeons.json quest list; in steps-v2 and questie-db (105 XP). Do not invent a class-weapon quest after 5730.

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.notes: Talk-only return to Thrall. Chain ends here (questie-db has no next). XP 1450 at level 16.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 13-18; do not enter before 16 (runAt).
warnings: Finish 5726/5727 (Skull Rock insignia, then Neeru) before accepting 5728.
Grab 5723 and 5722 from Rahauro on Elder Rise if you pass Thunder Bluff (Tauren will).
Skip 5725 unless already in Undercity; do not zeppelin for it.
Pull troggs in pairs; kill shaman first; Taragaman and Jergosh are the real threats.
Skip side caves unless you still need Maur's satchel.
Stop after 5730; no class-weapon follow-up exists in questie-db.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Crossroads harpy and raptor loops in nova/v2/barrens-12-20 are the slow outdoor XP in the same 13-16 band RFC pays at 16.
Skull Rock Burning Blade finishers in nova/v2/durotar-1-12 sit at the Orgrimmar gate; RFC is the next room after those turn-ins.

sourceConflicts: 5725 is in dungeons.json (balanced and speedrun) and README but has no steps-v2 accept/turnin; early-dungeon review dropped it because Varimathras is in Undercity while the Horde RFC pickup is in Orgrimmar.
5729 and 5730 are in steps-v2 and content/questie-db but omitted from the dungeons.json Ragefire quest list.
Classic Era XP in dungeons.json; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial). Amounts here are Classic Era base.
Thrall pin is 31.7, 37.8 in dungeons.json vs 31.73, 37.82 in steps-v2/questie-db; used catalog 31.7, 37.8.
notes: Horde-only instance. Pickup hub is Orgrimmar (Cleft of Shadow / Valley of Wisdom) at 13-16 between Durotar and the Barrens. Dungeons-off replacement: finish Durotar and early Northern Barrens from the Crossroads. One quested clear; do not reset-farm. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db.
